translation_notes: the 38 SEMSCI.<term> lookups of classes CHEMINF and SIO become prefixed names semsci:<term> under one '@prefix semsci: <http://semanticscience.org/resource/> .'; every other line is untouched

the SEMSCI DefinedNamespace class is KEPT as is: it is the module's public API (kif_lib.namespace.SEMSCI) and its URIRef annotations are rdflib's whitelist of declared terms, which @prefix cannot express. Consequence: the namespace IRI is now written twice (once in _NS = Namespace(...), once in @prefix) -- a real duplication the notation does not remove here.

nuance: SEMSCI.CHEMINF_000376 is validated by DefinedNamespaceMeta against the declared terms (a typo raises AttributeError at import), whereas semsci:CHEMINF_000376 is resolved by concatenation at transpile time. Same URIRef values (checked by the driver), weaker checking.
context shim: 'from ..rdflib import DefinedNamespace, Namespace, URIRef' -> local kif_rdflib.py, which is what kif_lib/rdflib.py re-exports. Identical for both sides.
demo harness added identically to both sides: the module declares namespaces only (no graph, no callable entry), so a trailing block prints the resulting name -> IRI table for the harness to compare
